rationale.ubuntu: Linux ext4/xfs with kernel page caching provides near-instantaneous git process spawns. Tolerances are locked at 25% following baseline SLA calibration for real container startup probes.
rationale.macos: APFS copy-on-write clonefile acceleration balanced against higher process spawn latency on Darwin kernels, calibrated to a tight 60% threshold with 5.0ms dynamic jitter floor.
rationale.windows: NTFS filesystem filter drivers, mandatory handle locking semantics, and real-time antivirus (Windows Defender) file-system interception introduce variable IO latency on rapid consecutive git.exe process spawns, calibrated to 100% threshold.
